plan: [ This is a one-shot, independent private values second-price auction. The dominant strategy is to bid my true value because my bid only determines whether I win, not the price I pay (which is the second-highest bid). Underbidding risks losing profitable wins; overbidding risks negative profit if I win above value. There’s no prior history to exploit. Therefore, bid exactly my value $21.0, in $0.1 increments as allowed. ]

In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding your true value is a weakly dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others’ bids. There's only one round, so no strategic signaling. My private value is 22; I should bid 22 to win whenever the second-highest bid is below 22 and pay that second-highest bid. Any higher or lower bid could only reduce expected payoff or risk losing profitable wins. Therefore, bid 22.

Second-price auction with independent private values. Dominant strategy is to bid true value: maximizes expected profit and avoids overbidding risk (negative payoff if second-highest exceeds value) and underbidding risk (unnecessarily losing when second-highest is below value). With value $13, set bid at 13. No history to exploit in round 1/1. Allow tie randomization if others also bid 13; EV zero if second-highest equals 13. Therefore, bid exactly my value: 13.
